findings.description: Response.__init__ now assigns self.reason from self.raw.reason, but self.raw is initialized to None in the same constructor, so this attribute access fails.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any Response() construction, such as the one in adapters.build_response or a direct Response() in user or test code. Mechanism: in __init__ self.raw is still None when line 793 runs, so self.raw.reason raises AttributeError. Impact: every Response object creation crashes, breaking all requests calls and direct Response instantiation.
